name: Stellar Outcast: Arena
detailed_description:
Stellar Outcast: Arena is a fast-paced, vibrant arcade space shooter that puts your reflexes and strategy to the test. Deploy your ship's energy reserves to boost and roll through relentless enemy fire, striking back with your own devastating precision-guided missiles. Between levels, power up your ship's lasers, missiles, and engines to stay one step ahead. With each level growing more intense, only your sharp piloting, smart energy management, and tactical upgrades will keep you in the fight.

KEY FEATURES:

Strategic Energy Management:
Master your ship's energy system by balancing engine boosts and daring tactical spins that make you momentarily untouchable. Energy is your lifeline—use it wisely to outmaneuver your foes.

Dual Weapons System:
Engage enemies with precision auto-targeting lasers that chip away at enemy health, or risk it all by turning to face threats head-on to launch powerful homing missiles. Deciding when to play it safe or go aggressive is critical to survival and victory.

Powerful Upgrades:
Boost your lasers, missiles, and engines to unlock high-skill moves like spinning invincibly while unleashing volleys of missiles or kiting enemies and letting your lasers wear them down.

Dynamic Arena Battles:
Navigate an intense, force-bounded combat arena. Shifting black holes can teleport you strategically across the battlefield, allowing for creative tactical repositioning.

High Score Tracking:

Keep your multiplier alive by avoiding damage while destroying enemies, and watch your score skyrocket. Aim for first place on your personal offline high score leaderboard.

Diverse Enemy Fleet & Capital Ships:
Face seven unique enemy ship types, including a formidable capital ship, across increasingly intense levels and waves.

Vivid 3D Visuals:
Immerse yourself in vibrant, detailed graphics with dynamic lighting that brings the action to life.

Ready to pilot your way to victory? Outmaneuver, outgun, and outlast the enemy in this indie arcade shooter.
